official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Create songs and instrumental music from descriptions or your own lyrics with Melyx AI. Describe a mood and style, bring your original lyrics, or request music without vocals. Connect your Melyx AI account to follow real task progress, listen to completed tracks, download the audio, and revisit your private music library. Custom lyrics mode defaults to a target of five minutes unless you request a different supported duration; actual output length may vary. Editing lyrics alone does not submit an audio-generation task.

limitations_ja: Melyx AIアカウント連携。自作歌詞モードの目標時間は標準5分だが実際の長さは変わる場合がある。
